bundle.longDescription: Girsa is an offline library of 7,189 seforim whose addresses survive being edited: every segment is named once and never renumbered, so a correction to the text cannot silently re-point ten thousand commentary links. It reads with commentary in the column beside the text, kept together by what the corpus declares rather than by resemblance.
